events.description: 9. GENERAL ORDER NO. 2025-01: This general order provides for the management and assignment of cases filed by a plaintiff or petitioner without counsel. This general order also includes the definition of the pro se docket, responsibilities of the pro se law clerks and scheduling and discovery requirements in pro se cases. Ordered by Chief Judge Robert F. Rossiter, Jr. Copy mailed to pro se party. (LRM) (Entered: 06/09/2026)

evidence.document: The docket as the RECAP Archive holds it

events.description: 10. MEMORANDUM AND ORDER Plaintiff's Motion for a temporary restraining order is denied. Defendants shall respond to Plaintiff's motion for a preliminary injunction within seven days of its receipt. A preliminary injunction hearing will be pro mptly set after the Court receives Defendants' response to Plaintiff's motion. Plaintiff is directed to serve Defendants with this Memorandum and Order, along with a copy of the Complaint (Filing No. 1 ) and motion for a preliminary injunc tion (Filing No. 4 ). Thereafter, Plaintiff must file a declaration with the Court indicating the date the Memorandum and Order, Complaint, and motion were provided to Defendants and the means in which the Defendants were served with the materials. The Clerk of Court is directed to mail a copy of this Memorandum and Order to Plaintiff at his address of record and additionally email a copy of this Memorandum and Order to Plaintiff at heyne777@gmail.com. Ordered by Judge Susan M. Bazis. Copy mailed and e-mailed to pro se party as directed. (LRM)
